description: 주소·장소 검색, PNU 또는 좌표로 필지 조회, 역지오코딩을 하고 필지 폴리곤과 면적을 돌려줍니다. / Search a Korean address or place, look up cadastral parcels by PNU or lat/lng, reverse-geocode a point, and return parcel polygons with their area (VWorld, as Site Finder).

address.description: A Korean parcel (지번) or road address to geocode; its parcel is returned.

lat.description: Latitude of a point; the parcel containing it is returned.

query.description: Place, POI, district or address text to search, for example an industrial complex or a district name.

reverse.description: Also reverse-geocode the point (or the geocoded address) to its parcel and road addresses.

name: find_site
title: Find a site (address, POI, parcel)
